title: Timing anchors that bracket the per-input nominal execution time

quantities.throughput_anchor_seconds: per-input nominal execution time implied by the multiply-add count W_nom of one nominal member execution at the sustained throughput measured for the plant on the deployment device (s); full-batch plants with a native dense layer only
quantities.training_anchor_low_seconds: lower end of the per-input forward-time bracket derived from the measured training time of one plant seed (s)

notes: Anchors are adopted timing references, kept apart from the measured t_nom of the nominal_time set. Each dataset carries its own anchors, also when Table S23b prints another plant's anchor as the reference range (COCO-SP shares the PascalVOC-SP anchor because the two plants have the same backbone, depth and graph size; the generator applies that convention). The throughput and training-time records (scheduler accounting of the plant seeds, epochs and training inputs, and the sustained-throughput measurement) go under raw/; deposit with `python -B scripts/export_records.py from-mapping --mapping <timing_anchors mapping>` once the set is registered for the mapping exporter.
